question: In a certain code language, ‘SINGER’ is written as ‘TKROUX’. How will ‘ROOKIE’ be written in that language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

‘SINGER’ is written as ‘TKROUX’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd13692fd462ea960253a8d540e65fb14098a26eb4b089c23bf250bf88062ed5.png] 

Similarly,

'**ROOKIE**' = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df250a91ba75aa9f002249549b63aa3997e27fdc0e883296efaa82e9a2e1b891.png] 

Hence, 'ROOKIE' is coded as "**SQSSYK**".
